title: Buttery
summary: BUT'TERY, adjective [from butter.] Having the qualities or appearance of butter. BUT'TERY, noun An apartment in a house, where butter, milk, provisions and utensils are kept. In some colleges, a room

inlines.v: BUT'TERY, adjective [from butter.] Having the qualities or appearance of butter. BUT'TERY, noun An apartment in a house, where butter, milk, provisions and utensils are kept. In some colleges, a room where liquors, fruit and refreshments are kept for sale to the students.
